Definition: Meribah, the name of two places in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Meribah = "strife" or "contention"; 1) a fountain at Rephidim, in the desert of Sin; so called because the Israelites murmured against God; 2) the name of the water supply at Kadesh on the southern border of the promised land; the people also murmured here against God
